Karp reduction
Karp reduction
(definition)
Definition:
A
reduction
given by a
polynomial
time
computable
transformation function.
See also
NP-complete
,
Turing reduction
,
Cook reduction
,
l-reduction
,
many-one reduction
,
polynomial-time reduction
.
